svg.title: Sequenced power rails and reset supervision
svg.text: ENER / SEQUENCED POWER RAILS AND RESET SUPERVISION
FHE + NEUROMORPHIC RELAY | REFERENCE DESIGN B | 2026-09-05
Schematic design and simulated logic; PCB and assembled hardware not validated.
U5 releases IO_ENABLE after the 1.2 V core rail exceeds its threshold; U6 then enables 2.5 V.
U7 holds CRESET_N low until 2.5 V is valid. CT = 1 nF gives about 6.2 ms nominal delay per supervisor.
Pull-ups R10/R11 are on C03; R7 on C03 also pulls up U7 open-drain output. All NC pins stay open.
